title: Chatham County Heat Action Plan - Chatham County, United States of America
organization: Chatham County Public Health Department; Chatham County Emergency Management
landscapes: Urban, Rural, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Athletics
description: This county-level heat action plan outlines Chatham County’s preparedness and response actions for excessive heat and heat waves, including seasonal readiness, Heat Watch and Heat Warning response phases, public alerts, cooling centers, emergency shelters, transportation support, and outreach to vulnerable populations. It also includes household cooling and energy-assistance resources, employer heat-awareness training, coordination with schools, libraries, health and emergency management agencies, and mapping of heat vulnerability and heat islands across the county.
